nom: SKIN1004 Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Enrich Cream

segments.oily: Reviewers describe oily-combination or oily skin as tolerating the cream well in winter, with one noting it works better seasonally than as a year-round product and another calling it great for oily-combination skin without issue.
segments.dry: Dry-skin reviewers, including those in cold or desert climates, consistently report deep hydration, relief of cracking or flaking, and no greasy after-feel.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report the cream absorbs well and hydrates without heaviness, though one combination-normal reviewer says it feels too rich for summer daytime use.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including one with sensitive acne-prone skin and one with sensitive flaky skin, report calming effects and no irritation, though one Ulta-bought unit was described as unusually greasy compared to the Korean original.
segments.mature: One reviewer connects continued use to firmer-feeling skin as part of an anti-aging routine.

concerns.aging: Two reviewers associate regular use with firmer, plumper-looking skin over time; no reviewer reports a negative effect on aging skin.
concerns.dehydration: The overwhelming majority of reviewers, across skin types, report strong, lasting hydration and plumper, smoother skin the next morning; no reviewer reports the cream failing to hydrate.
concerns.redness: Several reviewers report visibly reduced redness and calmer-looking skin within days to weeks of use; no reviewer reports increased redness.
concerns.barrier: Multiple reviewers credit the cream with strengthening or repairing a compromised skin barrier and soothing irritation; one reviewer specifically pairs it with an irritating active product and says it counteracts that irritation.
concerns.spots: One acne-prone reviewer reports no new breakouts and a long-term staple use with zero breakouts, while others report closed comedones, whiteheads, or a pimple after use, so results are mixed for spot-prone skin.
concerns.blemishes: Reports are split: some acne-prone or clog-prone users say the cream did not clog pores or cause new blemishes, while at least two reviewers report new closed comedones or a pimple linked to use.
concerns.oiliness: Most reviewers describe the finish as non-greasy and fast-absorbing even though the texture is rich, but one reviewer who compared it to the Korean-market version found the US/Ulta version noticeably more oily and greasy on her skin.

aspects.libelle: Bulky jar for amount of product

extraits.titre: Doesn't feel the same as the korean version
extraits.texte: It doesnt feel the same as the Korean version, i purchased this from ulta because I wouldn't have to pay extra shipping fees and i could just pick it up in person, but this version seems so much more oily!! The real one leaves my skin almost tacky/sticky but in a good way, this one just makes me so greasy. The real version got rid of all my redness and left my skin sooo supple, hydrated, and with an even skin tone when i woke up in the morning. I was trying to figure out what happened to my skin the past couple days and i realized its because this version i purchased from ulta is not the same. The real one truly is a holy grail skin care product for me so this is very disappointing. :(

extraits.titre: Not for the acne prone girls
extraits.texte: this has such an elegant texture going on, but unfortunately caused closed comedones and whiteheads for me. i loved using it aside from the breakouts it was giving me. i tried the ampoule from this line and had the same reaction. may work for someone who isn't acne prone.

extraits.titre: It's okay, just a little heavy for my skin
extraits.texte: Thank you to Skin1004 for sending me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program! I think this product is just okay. It is quite rich and thick which makes it luxurious but I got a pimple both times I used it which is out of the ordinary for me. I will use the rest of it on my body as a body butter because I do like the way it feels, it just didn't agree with my face.

I received this in exchange for my honest review! I'm always looking for a rich, hydrating cream for the dry winter months and this exceeded my expectations! I have incredibly dry skin normally and it's even worse in the winter. This helped heal my skin barrier and hydrate over night so I looked fresh the next day!

I've been using the Madagascar Centella Probio-Cica Enrich Cream for a few days now and I'm genuinely impressed with it. The texture is rich but still feels lightweight, and it absorbs quickly without leaving any greasy or sticky feeling. My skin feels well moisturized, softer, and noticeably calmer. I've also seen a reduction in redness and irritation, which has been a big benefit for me. Compared to other creams I've tried, this one feels much more soothing and supportive for my skin barrier. It doesn't just sit on top of the skin, it feels like it's helping strengthen and balance my skin over time. I've been able to use it both morning and night without any irritation, which is great since my skin can be sensitive. I would definitely consider buying this product in the future. It has quickly become a part of my routine because it hydrates well without causing any issues. I'd also recommend it to anyone with sensitive or reactive skin, or anyone looking for a calming and nourishing moisturizer. I received this product as part of a free sample program, but all opinions are my own.

My first Skin1004 product and I'm obsessed! Super calming and perfect for my sensitive acne-prone skin. The Centella Asiatica extract ingredient in this is so good for calming irritation. The texture is lightweight and absorbs well without being too sticky. I didn't detect any strong fragrance, which I prefer in my skincare products. Packaging is sleek and practical; love the spoon that comes with it to scoop out the cream without using my fingers. Thank you to Skin1004 for sending me this free sample through the BzzAgent sampling program!
I love this cream. I think it's intensely hydrating for my dry skin but it doesn't feel oily or leave any residue in the morning. It also hasn't caused any irritation which I love!
